scope: Frozen-code new-publisher caption transfer. First result hosted by PMC in the stated search, before any DocWeave extraction. Retain the source if retrieval or extraction fails; no source replacement based on scores.
selection_rule: First returned result hosted at pmc.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov with Scientific Reports2026 metadata (other search results hosted by Nature or repositories are not PMC results).
reference_rule: All main-body publisher JATS figure captions; unchanged exact ASCII-whitespace-only scorer. No punctuation/Unicode/hyphen repair, per-source threshold winner or caption model tuning.
